description.value:
Your cards are extensions of your reach into the wide world, and you can shift to wherever they may land. You @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.classes.hsCJT2h2dgISso8T]{Play Card} and toss it to a space within 30 feet of you, and a force shifts you towards it. If you are unable to move towards it (such as if the movement would make you collide with a creature), you move as close as possible to it. The suit of the card determines how you maneuver to where your card is tossed.

  • Strength/Constitution: The force slides you up to 30 feet towards the card as if you made a Stride, ignoring difficult terrain and treating greater difficult terrain as difficult terrain.

  • Dexterity/Intelligence: You are launched in an arc as if you did a Leap, up to 30 feet vertically and horizontally towards the card.

  • Wisdom/Charisma: You teleport to the space.
